add_definitions(-D_COMDDK_)

include_directories(
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/reactos/libs/sound)

# wdmaud.sys is all Rust (wdmaud-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/wdmaud-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# control.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/wdmaud-rust/src/wdmaud/control.rs)
# deviface.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/wdmaud-rust/src/wdmaud/deviface.rs)
# entry.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/wdmaud-rust/src/wdmaud/entry.rs)
# mmixer.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/wdmaud-rust/src/wdmaud/mmixer.rs)
# sup.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/wdmaud-rust/src/wdmaud/sup.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(wdmaud_res OBJECT wdmaud.rc)
target_include_directories(wdmaud_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(WDMAUD_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/drivers/sound/mmixer/libmmixer_rust.a)
add_cargo_module(wdmaud wdmaud-cargo wdmaud.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    BODY_CRATE wdmaud-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    EXTRA_DEPENDS wdmaud_res ${WDMAUD_REUSED} asm psdk)
